block.aiarsenal.launch_computer.desc: Right-click to open. Sees pads within 48 blocks, aims by map or coordinates, sets the spread, arms and fires a salvo with a countdown.
block.aiarsenal.launch_computer.desc1: 1) Place the computer within 48 blocks of the pads.
block.aiarsenal.launch_computer.desc2: 2) Select pads, set a target by map or coordinates.
block.aiarsenal.launch_computer.desc3: 3) Arm -> LAUNCH: 12 s countdown, sirens, crane retracts, salvo at 1 s intervals.
block.aiarsenal.launch_pad_1.desc: A concrete block 1 high with a launch table and a slewing crane (4 blocks tall). Accepts tactical and cruise missiles.
block.aiarsenal.launch_pad_1.desc1: Needs solid ground and free space.
block.aiarsenal.launch_pad_1.desc2: Right-click with a missile: the crane loads it (~7 s). Shift+right-click empty-handed: unload.
block.aiarsenal.launch_pad_2.desc: Takes 2x2 blocks, 1.5 high, 6.5-block crane. Accepts 1x1 and 2x2 (operational) missiles.
block.aiarsenal.launch_pad_2.desc1: Needs solid ground and a free 2x2 area (extends +X, +Z from the clicked block).
block.aiarsenal.launch_pad_2.desc2: Right-click with a missile: loaded by the crane. Shift+right-click empty-handed: unload.
block.aiarsenal.launch_pad_3.desc: Takes 3x3 blocks, 2 high, 10-block crane. Accepts any missile including ICBMs.
block.aiarsenal.launch_pad_3.desc2: Right-click with a missile: loaded by the crane. Shift+right-click empty-handed: unload.
block.aiarsenal.little_boy.desc: Gun-type uranium bomb, dropped on Hiroshima on 6 August 1945.
block.aiarsenal.rds_4.desc: Implosion bomb, the first Soviet air-droppable atomic bomb. Tested on 23 August 1953.
block.aiarsenal.reinforced_concrete.desc: Protects from shock waves better than stone.
block.aiarsenal.scorched_earth.desc1: Scorched earth left by a nuclear blast.
block.aiarsenal.scorched_earth.desc2: Grass does not grow on it.
block.aiarsenal.siren.desc: 2 blocks tall. Driven by the launch computer or a redstone signal; right-click to test. Audible from afar.
block.aiarsenal.siren.desc1: Takes 2 blocks of height. Horns spin and wail during an alarm.
block.aiarsenal.steel_block.desc2: Used for machine housings and launch pads.
block.aiarsenal.trinitite.desc1: Trinitite: glass of fused sand from ground zero.
block.aiarsenal.uranium_ore.desc1: Uranium ore. y=-64..32, veins of 5, ~3 per chunk.
block.aiarsenal.uranium_ore.desc2: Iron pickaxe required. Drops raw uranium.
command.aiarsenal.rw.nuke.disabled: Nuclear detonations are disabled in the config (nuclearEnabled=false)

death.attack.aiarsenal.nuclear_thermal.p: %1$s was burned by the flash while fleeing %2$s
death.attack.aiarsenal.radiation.player: %1$s died of radiation sickness while fleeing %2$s

gui.aiarsenal.rw.radar.nolink: NO RADAR LINK - a radar within 250 blocks is required

hud.aiarsenal.rw.g.sit_door: Sit near a seat / exit at the door

hud.aiarsenal.rw.heading: HDG
hud.aiarsenal.rw.no_radar: No radar within 250 blocks - no air picture
hud.aiarsenal.rw.gun.wrong_round: OTHER ROUND IN THE BREECH - [R] TO RELOAD
hud.aiarsenal.rw.sight_keys: Z / RMB — zoom · M — target map · LMB — fire
hud.aiarsenal.tablet_no_target: TABLET: no target · Shift+RMB to designate
hud.aiarsenal.title: BM-21 "Grad"
item.aiarsenal.arming_plug.desc: Use on a bomb to arm or disarm it. An unarmed bomb will not detonate.
item.aiarsenal.armored_cab.desc: Crew cab with windows and seats.
item.aiarsenal.artillery_designator.desc: Right-click a point to mark a target. An MLRS operator carrying it gets a firing solution.
item.aiarsenal.barometric_fuze.desc: Fires at a set altitude above ground (airburst).
item.aiarsenal.bridgewire_detonator.desc: A thin wire vaporizes from a current pulse: timing jitter in fractions of a microsecond.
item.aiarsenal.chassis_6x6.desc: Frame with three driven axles (Ural-375D type).
item.aiarsenal.chassis_8x8.desc: Frame with four driven axles (MAZ-543M / MZKT-7930 type).
item.aiarsenal.diesel_engine.desc: Powerful V-type diesel for a heavy chassis.
item.aiarsenal.fab1500.desc: 1500 kg HE bomb for the Tu-95 bomb bay.
item.aiarsenal.fab500.desc: 500 kg HE bomb. Hang it in the Tu-95 bomb bay (right-click under the fuselage). Contact fuze arms 1.5 s after release.
item.aiarsenal.fab5000.desc: Super-heavy 5000 kg HE bomb. The bay takes two.
item.aiarsenal.flak_ammo_box.desc: 50 belted rounds (API and HEI) for the ZU-23-2.
item.aiarsenal.geiger_counter.desc: Clicks in your inventory; hold it to see dose rate and accumulated dose.
item.aiarsenal.grad_rocket.desc: 122 mm, 66 kg, 18 kg HE-fragmentation warhead. Loaded into the BM-21 from the operator seat (R).
item.aiarsenal.grad_vehicle.desc: MLRS on a Ural-375D chassis, 40 tubes of 122 mm. Right-click the ground to place.
item.aiarsenal.guidance_unit.desc: Autopilot and computer of the missile.
item.aiarsenal.gun_mount_23.desc: Carriage with wheels, jacks and gunner seat.
item.aiarsenal.hydraulic_drive.desc: Cylinder and pump: jacks, launcher elevation and traverse.
item.aiarsenal.lb_casing.desc: For Little Boy: core + casing + barometric fuze.
item.aiarsenal.missile_cruise_cluster.de: Releases 48 x 14 kg bomblets over ~34 blocks above the target.
item.aiarsenal.missile_cruise_he.desc: Flies low following the terrain (~26 blocks), dives at the end and detonates on collision.
item.aiarsenal.missile_icbm_he.desc: Intercontinental missile with a 9 t HE warhead. Needs a 3x3 pad.
item.aiarsenal.missile_icbm_kinetic.desc: 6.5 t inert warhead: a huge crater, almost no fire.
item.aiarsenal.missile_icbm_mirv_heavy.d: Eight 3.2 t warheads over ~230 blocks: destroys an entire city.
item.aiarsenal.missile_operational_he.de: Medium-range ballistic missile, 1.6 t warhead. Needs a 2x2 pad.
item.aiarsenal.missile_operational_kinet: 1 t inert warhead: a very deep crater, no fires.
item.aiarsenal.missile_operational_penet: Burrows up to 20 blocks down and detonates deep: a bunker buster.
item.aiarsenal.missile_tactical_he.desc: Iskander-class short-range ballistic missile. 500 kg HE warhead.
Inert warhead: a deep crater with no fire or fragments.
item.aiarsenal.missile_tactical_mirv.des: Three 160 kg warheads scatter around the target.
item.aiarsenal.missile_tactical_thermoba: Fuel-air blast: burns everything alive within ~30 blocks and sets fires.
item.aiarsenal.potassium_iodide.desc: Reduces accumulated radiation dose by 40 rem.
item.aiarsenal.proximity_fuze.desc: Detonates the warhead near the target.
item.aiarsenal.radar_mobile_vehicle.desc: Wheeled air-surveillance radar. When on its jacks it feeds the air picture to S-400 and similar systems within 250 blocks. Sit inside and press M for the map with all targets.
item.aiarsenal.radar_post_vehicle.desc: Stationary radar post: a building with a console and a rotating antenna on a tower. Feeds the air picture to S-400 within 250 blocks (600-block coverage). Sit at the console and press M.
item.aiarsenal.rds_casing.desc: For RDS-4 (1 core), RDS-1 (2 cores) and AN602 (4 cores, 2 casings).
item.aiarsenal.rds_core.desc: Workbench: 8 uranium ingots + TNT. Core + casing + barometric fuze = bomb.
item.aiarsenal.remote_detonator.desc: Shift+Use on a bomb to link. Use to detonate the armed bomb.
item.aiarsenal.rocket_motor_122.desc: Casing with a propellant charge and nozzle.
item.aiarsenal.rocket_motor_300.desc: Heavy solid-fuel motor for the Smerch.
item.aiarsenal.s400_vehicle.desc: SAM launcher on a MZKT-7930 with four 48N6E2 missiles. Seat 2 is the system operator.
item.aiarsenal.sam_48n6.desc: S-400 SAM: vertical launch, homing, proximity fuze.
item.aiarsenal.smerch_rocket.desc: 300 mm, 800 kg, 280 kg HE warhead. Loaded into the BM-30 (R).
item.aiarsenal.smerch_vehicle.desc: MLRS on a MAZ-543M 8x8, 12 tubes of 300 mm, range up to 70 km. Right-click the ground to place.
item.aiarsenal.tu95_vehicle.desc: Strategic bomber, 49 m. Right-click the ground to place. Board by right-clicking at the port-side door. Walk inside, take a seat (X), take off and release bombs.
item.aiarsenal.warhead_122.desc: 9N22 HE-fragmentation warhead with a contact fuze.
item.aiarsenal.zu23_vehicle.desc: Twin 23 mm anti-aircraft gun. It only fires from the gunner's seat.

rocket.aiarsenal.9m218.desc: Opens above the target and releases 45 HEAT-frag bomblets.
rocket.aiarsenal.9m22s.desc: Thermite elements set the target area on fire.
rocket.aiarsenal.9m22u.desc: Standard high-explosive fragmentation round. Blast + 70 fragments.
rocket.aiarsenal.9m28f.desc: Heavy blast charge: large crater, flying debris.
rocket.aiarsenal.9m43.desc: Creates a 30 s smoke screen: blindness, mobs lose targets.

tooltip.aiarsenal.bm21.2: Use on the ground to deploy. Sneak + empty hand on the vehicle packs it up.

tooltip.aiarsenal.kh55: Air-launched cruise missile · Tu-95/Tu-160 rotary launcher
tooltip.aiarsenal.liutyi: Twin-boom pusher drone · runway takeoff · 75 kg warhead
tooltip.aiarsenal.mq9: Long-endurance turboprop UAV · 4 Hellfire · gimbal camera up to 40×
tooltip.aiarsenal.orion: Russian MALE UAV · 4 KAB-50 guided bombs · gimbal camera

tooltip.aiarsenal.shahed131: Smaller delta · 15 kg warhead · Wankel engine
tooltip.aiarsenal.shahed136: Delta-wing loitering munition · 50 kg warhead · piston "moped" engine
tooltip.aiarsenal.shahed_rail: Launch rail with rocket booster for Shahed drones

tooltip.aiarsenal.tu160: Strategic swing-wing bomber: 4x NK-32 with afterburner, sweep 20-65 deg, 4 crew
tooltip.aiarsenal.tu95ms: Strategic turboprop bomber: 4x NK-12MP, contra-rotating props, 7 crew, walkable cabin
tooltip.aiarsenal.use_bomber: Load into a Tu-95MS / Tu-160 bomb bay; set target with the tablet
tooltip.aiarsenal.use_cruise: Load into the cruise missile launcher (RMB on it)

tooltip.aiarsenal.use_recon: RMB on ground: place · RMB with the tablet to link and fly
tooltip.aiarsenal.use_tel: Load into the Yars mobile launcher (RMB on it)
tooltip.aiarsenal.yars: Three-stage solid ICBM · MIRV bus · 300 kt warhead
tooltip.aiarsenal.yars_tel: 16×16 · driver + launch officer · map/radar launch · cold launch
msg.aiarsenal.rw.yars_armed: Launch authorised: stop, jacks, TPK up — fires automatically
msg.aiarsenal.rw.yars_need_lock: Confirm the target (G) or press LAUNCH on the map
gui.aiarsenal.rw.radar.nolink_yars: No radar link — map targeting only
gui.aiarsenal.rw.radar.help_yars: LMB on map — aim point · LMB on a blip — radar target (tracked) · RMB+drag — pan · wheel — zoom · LAUNCH — erect and fire
tooltip.aiarsenal.sandbags: Connects into a wall · absorbs blasts
tooltip.aiarsenal.barbed_wire: Connects like a fence · entangles and cuts · vehicles crush it
tooltip.aiarsenal.concertina_wire: Slows and cuts harder · vehicles crush it
tooltip.aiarsenal.camo_net: Hangs in the air over a position · lets light through
tooltip.aiarsenal.igla: IR homing against air targets · drones, aircraft, missiles
tooltip.aiarsenal.javelin: Locks a vehicle or a point · top attack · fire-and-forget
tooltip.aiarsenal.igla_missile: Launch tube with missile and 9B238 power/coolant unit · 2.5 kg HE-frag · proximity + impact fuze
tooltip.aiarsenal.javelin_missile: Tandem HEAT warhead · hits armour from above
tooltip.aiarsenal.hh.use_rpg: RMB — fire / hold — reload · 6 m danger zone behind
tooltip.aiarsenal.hh.use_guided: Hold RMB and keep the target in the frame until it locks · release to launch
hud.aiarsenal.rw.gun.no_target: No target: set it on the map or with the designator
item.aiarsenal.t90m_vehicle.desc: Main battle tank, 125 mm 2A46M-4, autoloader 22 rounds, Relikt ERA. Driver + gunner (switch seats with the seat key). Right-click the ground to place.
item.aiarsenal.abrams_vehicle.desc: US main battle tank, 120 mm M256, 34 ready rounds in the bustle, gas-turbine 1500 hp. Right-click the ground to place.
item.aiarsenal.bmp3_vehicle.desc: Infantry fighting vehicle: 100 mm 2A70 launcher-gun + coaxial 30 mm 2A72 autocannon (switch with the lock key). Right-click the ground to place.
item.aiarsenal.msta_vehicle.desc: 152 mm self-propelled howitzer 2A64, 50 rounds, range ~24.7 km. Map target / designator auto-laying. Right-click the ground to place.
item.aiarsenal.d30_vehicle.desc: 122 mm towed howitzer on a three-trail carriage, all-round traverse, range ~15.4 km. Right-click the ground to place.
item.aiarsenal.m777_vehicle.desc: 155 mm lightweight towed howitzer (titanium), +-22.5 deg traverse, range ~24 km. Right-click the ground to place.
item.aiarsenal.shells_125.desc: For the T-90M: HE-FRAG 3OF26 and APFSDS 3BM60 (selected in the vehicle).
item.aiarsenal.shells_120.desc: For the M1A2: M830A1 MPAT and M829A4 APFSDS.
item.aiarsenal.shells_100.desc: For the BMP-3 2A70 gun (HE-FRAG 3OF32). Reloading also tops up the 30 mm belt.
item.aiarsenal.shells_122.desc: For the D-30 howitzer, 21.8 kg HE-FRAG.
item.aiarsenal.ka52.tip: Coaxial attack helicopter, 2 crew. 30 mm 2A42, 12 Vikhr ATGM, 40 S-8 rockets, flares. Place on the ground.
item.aiarsenal.ah64.tip: Attack helicopter, tandem crew. 30 mm M230 slaved to the helmet, 8 Hellfire, 38 Hydra, flares.
item.aiarsenal.raptor.tip: Fast patrol boat, 48 kn, 14.5 mm KPVT remote turret, 2 crew + 4 troops. Place on water.
item.aiarsenal.cb90.tip: Swedish waterjet assault craft, 42 kn, turns on the spot, 12.7 mm M2. Place on water.
item.aiarsenal.sub636.tip: Diesel-electric submarine, 74 m. 6 bow tubes, 18 homing torpedoes. Ballast, hydroplanes, battery. Place on deep water.
item.aiarsenal.craft_service_kit.tip: Right-click a helicopter/boat/submarine: full ammo, fuel, battery, +30 % structure.
craft.aiarsenal.no_exit_air: Cannot exit in flight - land first

craft.aiarsenal.flameout: Engine flame-out! Relight with H or autorotate
item.aiarsenal.pz2_vehicle.desc: German light tank (1941), 9.5 t, 4.81 x 2.28 x 2.15 m. 2 cm KwK 30 (10-round magazines, HE / AP) + coaxial MG 34. Driver + commander-gunner. Right-click the ground to place.
item.aiarsenal.pz4_vehicle.desc: German medium tank (1943), 25 t, 7.02 x 2.88 x 2.68 m, Schürzen. 7.5 cm KwK 40 L/48 (HE / Pzgr 39) + MG 34. Right-click the ground to place.
item.aiarsenal.tiger_vehicle.desc: German heavy tank, 57 t, 8.45 x 3.70 x 3.00 m, interleaved road wheels. 8.8 cm KwK 36 L/56 (HE / Pzgr 39) + MG 34. Slow hydraulic turret traverse. Right-click the ground to place.
item.aiarsenal.sturmtiger_vehicle.desc: 38 cm Sturmmörser on the Tiger chassis, 65 t, 6.28 m. RW 61 rocket mortar: 345 kg round, 135 kg charge, up to 5.6 km. Map / designator auto-laying, crane reload. Right-click the ground to place.
item.aiarsenal.maus_vehicle.desc: German super-heavy tank, 188 t, 10.09 x 3.67 x 3.63 m. 12.8 cm KwK 44 L/55 (HE / AP) + coaxial 7.5 cm KwK 44 L/36.5 + MG 34. 20 km/h. Right-click the ground to place.
item.aiarsenal.ratte_vehicle.desc: German land cruiser project, 1000 t, 35 x 14 x 11 m, three tracks per side. Twin 28 cm SK C/34 naval guns (fire in turn), rear 12.8 cm turret, Flak 38, MG 151/15. Right-click the ground to place.
item.aiarsenal.t34_vehicle.desc: Soviet medium tank (1944), 32 t, 8.15 x 3.00 x 2.72 m, Christie suspension. 85 mm ZiS-S-53 (O-365 / BR-365) + coaxial DT, 55 km/h. Right-click the ground to place.
item.aiarsenal.kv2_vehicle.desc: Soviet heavy assault tank (1940), 52 t, 6.95 x 3.32 x 3.24 m, 152 mm M-10T howitzer in a tall turret (OF-530), separate loading. Right-click the ground to place.
item.aiarsenal.is2_vehicle.desc: Soviet heavy breakthrough tank, 46 t, 9.90 x 3.07 x 2.73 m. 122 mm D-25T (OF-471 / BR-471), 2-3 rounds/min, + coaxial DT. Right-click the ground to place.
item.aiarsenal.kv5_vehicle.desc: Soviet super-heavy tank project (1941), 100 t, 4.0 m wide, driver tower and MG turret. 107 mm ZiS-6 (OF-420) + DT. Right-click the ground to place.
item.aiarsenal.bm13_vehicle.desc: Soviet rocket launcher on the Studebaker US6 6x6: 16 M-13 132 mm rockets on 8 rails, salvo in 7-10 s, up to 8.5 km. Lower the jacks before firing. Right-click the ground to place.
item.aiarsenal.shells_20.desc: For the Pz.II: 10-round magazines, HE 0.148 kg / AP.
item.aiarsenal.shells_75.desc: For the Pz.IV (KwK 40 L/48) and the Maus second gun.
item.aiarsenal.shells_88.desc: For the Tiger I: Sprgr 9.5 kg / Pzgr 39 10.2 kg.
item.aiarsenal.shells_128.desc: For the Maus: separate loading, 28 kg projectile.
item.aiarsenal.shells_280.desc: For the Ratte: 315 kg HE shell + bagged charges.
item.aiarsenal.rocket_380.desc: For the Sturmtiger: 345 kg, 135 kg charge.
item.aiarsenal.rocket_m13.desc: For the BM-13: 42.5 kg, 4.9 kg TNT, range 8.5 km.
item.aiarsenal.pz2.desc: German light tank (1941), 9.5 t, 4.81 x 2.28 x 2.15 m. 2 cm KwK 30 (10-round magazines, HE / AP) + coaxial MG 34. One crewman: WASD drive, mouse aim, LMB fire, RMB sight.
item.aiarsenal.ratte.desc: German land cruiser project, 1000 t, 35 x 14 x 11 m, plain panzer grey. Twin 28 cm SK C/34 (fire in turn) under your mouse; the aft 12.8 cm turret and eight Flak 38 in sunken tubs fight on their own. Side door + stair: walk through the driver room, turret basket, magazine and engine room.
item.aiarsenal.bismarck.tip: Kriegsmarine battleship, May 1941, 1:1 (251 m). 8x38 cm, 12x15 cm, 16x10.5 cm, 16x3.7 cm, 2 cm flak, 4 Arado Ar 196 floatplanes. Walkable decks. Place on deep open water.
hud.aiarsenal.craft.hint_bs1: W/S telegraph  A/D rudder  H engines  Shift exit  (flak fires by itself)
hud.aiarsenal.craft.hint_bs2: Mouse = director aim, LMB fire (38 cm half-salvo / 15 cm / launch Arado), G weapon, RMB/Z sight x6
item.aiarsenal.bf109.tip: German WW2 fighter, DB 605A 1475 hp. 20 mm MG 151/20 through the hub + 2 x 13 mm MG 131. Place on flat ground (runway).
item.aiarsenal.yak3.tip: Soviet WW2 fighter, VK-105PF2. 20 mm ShVAK + 2 x 12.7 mm UBS. The lightest, most agile fighter of the war. Place on flat ground.
item.aiarsenal.he111.tip: German WW2 medium bomber, 2 x Jumo 211F. Up to 2000 kg: 8 x SC 250 inside, 2 x SC 1000 outside. MG FF + 3 defensive positions fire by themselves. Crew 5.
item.aiarsenal.pe8.tip: Soviet WW2 heavy bomber, 4 x AM-35A. 16 x FAB-250, 4 x FAB-1000 or 1 x FAB-5000. 5 defensive turrets (ShKAS, ShVAK, UBT) fire by themselves. Crew 11.
item.aiarsenal.sc1000.desc: German 1000 kg thin-cased blast bomb (He 111 external racks).
item.aiarsenal.fab250sv.desc: Soviet 250 kg HE bomb, welded case (Pe-8).
craft.aiarsenal.gear_ground: Can't raise the gear on the ground
craft.aiarsenal.load_ground: Bomb load can only be changed standing on the ground
craft.aiarsenal.load_he111_2: Load: 4 x SC 250 + 1 x SC 1000 (2000 kg)
hud.aiarsenal.craft.warn_stall_plane: STALL - push the nose down, add power

hud.aiarsenal.craft.hint_crew_plane: Crew position. The gunners fire by themselves; X - change seat, Shift - exit
craft.aiarsenal.load_su57_0: Load: universal - 2 S-8 pods, 2 Kh-38, 2 FAB-500 in the bays
craft.aiarsenal.load_su57_3: Load: rockets - 4 S-8 pods (80), 4 FAB-500 internal
hud.aiarsenal.craft.hint_plane2_jet: LMB fire  G weapon  V gear  N manoeuvre mode  W>86% afterburner  R load (ground)  B flares  Shift exit
item.aiarsenal.bradley_vehicle.desc: US infantry fighting vehicle: 25 mm M242 Bushmaster (HEI-T / APFSDS-T dual feed), twin TOW-2B launcher, 7.62 mm coax. 30.4 t, 61 km/h. Right-click the ground to place.
item.aiarsenal.tos1a_vehicle.desc: Heavy flamethrower system on the T-72A chassis: 24 x 220 mm thermobaric rockets, full salvo in 6 s, 0.6-6 km. Hydraulic rams raise the pack. Right-click the ground to place.
item.aiarsenal.ural_vehicle.desc: Soviet/Russian 6x6 army truck: 2 cab seats and a tented bed with benches for 12 soldiers, 85 km/h, excellent off-road. Right-click the ground to place.
item.aiarsenal.shells_25.desc: For the M2 Bradley: 25x137 mm, HEI-T 0.183 kg / APFSDS-T.
item.aiarsenal.rocket_220.desc: For the TOS-1A: thermobaric, 217 kg, 3.72 m, range 6 km.
hud.aiarsenal.rw.gun.sel.tow2b: Weapon: TOW-2B ATGM (wire-guided, keep the sight on target)
block.aiarsenal.trench_wall.desc1: Earth block revetted with boards on the trench side. The entrenching tool places them automatically.
block.aiarsenal.trench_wall_tin.desc1: Earth block held by corrugated steel and angle-iron pickets.
block.aiarsenal.duckboard.desc1: Wooden trench grating, keeps boots out of the mud.
block.aiarsenal.firing_step.desc1: Half-height earth step with a plank riser for firing over the parapet.
block.aiarsenal.fuel_drum_olive.desc1: 200 l of diesel. Sneak to lay it on its side. Blasts, fire and burning arrows make it burst into flames.
block.aiarsenal.fuel_drum_red.desc1: 200 l of gasoline. Sneak to lay it on its side. Blasts, fire and burning arrows make it burst into flames.
block.aiarsenal.fuel_drum_blue.desc1: 200 l of engine oil. Sneak to lay it on its side. Blasts, fire and burning arrows make it burst into flames.
block.aiarsenal.egoza.desc1: Flat-pressed razor-tape spiral (ASKL). Joins like a fence, cuts and holds; vehicles crush it.
block.aiarsenal.bruno_spiral.desc1: Double razor coil with clipped crossing loops. The nastiest wire obstacle.
block.aiarsenal.mine_pmn2.desc1: Pressure mine, 100 g TNT-class charge. Arms 3 s after placing. Sneak + shears to disarm.
block.aiarsenal.mine_tm62.desc1: 7.5 kg TNT, triggered only by vehicles and very heavy creatures.
block.aiarsenal.mine_mon50.desc1: Points where you look. Break-wire 6 blocks ahead; 54° sheaf of 540 steel balls.
block.aiarsenal.mine_ozm72.desc1: Jumps to waist height before bursting — lethal radius 25 blocks.
block.aiarsenal.tripwire_f1.desc1: Wire runs 2 blocks to the right; the fuze burns 3-4 s after the pull.
block.aiarsenal.bear_trap.desc1: Snaps shut on whoever steps on it and holds them. Right-click to open again.
block.aiarsenal.warning_sign_mines.desc1: Place on the ground for a post sign, on a wall side for a wall plate.
block.aiarsenal.warning_sign_radiation.d: Place on the ground for a post sign, on a wall side for a wall plate.
block.aiarsenal.warning_sign_voltage.des: Place on the ground for a post sign, on a wall side for a wall plate.
block.aiarsenal.warning_sign_biohazard.d: Place on the ground for a post sign, on a wall side for a wall plate.
Place on the ground for a post sign, on a wall side for a wall plate.
block.aiarsenal.warning_sign_noentry.des: Place on the ground for a post sign, on a wall side for a wall plate.
item.aiarsenal.entrenching_tool.desc1: Right-click the ground: start of a trench; right-click a second point: the trench is dug (with a turn if needed). The plan shows through the ground while aiming.
item.aiarsenal.entrenching_tool.desc2: Sneak + right-click a block: dig one block. Sneak + right-click in the air: cancel the start point.
msg.aiarsenal.trench.start: Trench start: %s. Aim at the end point and right-click (max %s blocks). Sneak + right-click in the air: cancel.
msg.aiarsenal.trench.nothing: Nothing to dig here - no soil along the line
msg.aiarsenal.trench.dig: Digging a trench: %s m (%s skipped - not soil)
block.aiarsenal.flagpole.desc1: Stack it as high as you like; the top gets a gilded finial. Put a flag on top.
block.aiarsenal.flag_russia.desc1: Waves in the wind (stronger in rain). Place it on top of a flagpole; the front faces you.
block.aiarsenal.flag_ussr.desc1: Waves in the wind (stronger in rain). Place it on top of a flagpole; the front faces you.

block.aiarsenal.flag_vdv: Flag of the Russian Airborne Troops (VDV)
block.aiarsenal.flag_vdv.desc1: Waves in the wind (stronger in rain). Place it on top of a flagpole; the front faces you.
block.aiarsenal.flag_vmf.desc1: Waves in the wind (stronger in rain). Place it on top of a flagpole; the front faces you.
block.aiarsenal.flag_vks: Flag of the Russian Aerospace Forces
block.aiarsenal.flag_vks.desc1: Waves in the wind (stronger in rain). Place it on top of a flagpole; the front faces you.
block.aiarsenal.flag_nato.desc1: Waves in the wind (stronger in rain). Place it on top of a flagpole; the front faces you.
block.aiarsenal.flag_un.desc1: Waves in the wind (stronger in rain). Place it on top of a flagpole; the front faces you.
block.aiarsenal.flag_white.desc1: Waves in the wind (stronger in rain). Place it on top of a flagpole; the front faces you.
block.aiarsenal.flag_victory.desc1: Waves in the wind (stronger in rain). Place it on top of a flagpole; the front faces you.
block.aiarsenal.lantern_hurricane.desc1: Stands on the floor, or hangs on a chain when placed under a ceiling. Right-click: light / put out.
block.aiarsenal.lamp_bulkhead.desc1: Screws to a floor, wall or ceiling. Right-click or redstone switches it.
block.aiarsenal.lamp_street.desc1: Cobra-head LED light on a wall bracket: click the side of a wall or post.
block.aiarsenal.lamp_flood.desc1: LED work light on a tripod, shines where you looked when placing it.
block.aiarsenal.beacon_red.desc1: Blinks once a second. Put it on masts, towers and roofs.
block.aiarsenal.beacon_rotating.desc1: Orange rotating mirror beacon - gates, checkpoints, service vehicles. Redstone switches it.
block.aiarsenal.searchlight.desc1: Right-click: off / fixed / sweep. Sneak + right-click with an empty hand: aim where you look. Lights up where the beam lands; detected hostiles and strangers glow, redstone output while it sees someone; in sweep mode it locks on and follows.
block.aiarsenal.armor_plate.desc1: Riveted rolled armour steel. Very blast-resistant.
block.aiarsenal.armor_plate_hazard.desc1: Yellow-black chevrons for gates and barriers.
block.aiarsenal.armor_plate_star_red.des: Soviet red star with a white edge.
block.aiarsenal.armor_plate_us_star.desc: Allied white star in a circle.
tooltip.aiarsenal.uniform.ru_private: EMR 'tsifra' field uniform, 6B47 helmet, plain olive shoulder boards.
tooltip.aiarsenal.uniform.ru_sergeant: EMR field uniform, 6B47 helmet; shoulder boards with three gold bars.
tooltip.aiarsenal.uniform.ru_captain: EMR field uniform and field cap; boards: one stripe, four small stars.
tooltip.aiarsenal.uniform.ru_colonel: Olive everyday uniform, peaked cap with a red band; boards: two red stripes, three large stars.
tooltip.aiarsenal.uniform.ru_general: Olive everyday uniform, red trouser stripes, gold-embroidered visor; gold zigzag boards, three large stars.
tooltip.aiarsenal.uniform.us_private: OCP uniform, ACH helmet; PV2 chevron on the chest tab.
tooltip.aiarsenal.uniform.us_sergeant: OCP uniform, ACH helmet; three chevrons on the chest tab.
tooltip.aiarsenal.uniform.us_captain: OCP uniform and patrol cap; two bars on the chest tab and cap.
tooltip.aiarsenal.uniform.us_colonel: Army Green Service Uniform: dark olive coat, taupe trousers, service cap; eagle on the shoulder loops.
tooltip.aiarsenal.uniform.us_general: Army Green Service Uniform; four stars on the shoulder loops, two rows of oak leaves on the visor.
block.aiarsenal.door_steel.desc1: Riveted 7 cm olive leaf in a steel frame. Opens by hand or redstone.
block.aiarsenal.door_bunker.desc1: 16 cm sealed leaf with clamp dogs: the wheel spins first, then the heavy leaf swings (2 s). Very blast-resistant.
block.aiarsenal.door_bars.desc1: Steel bar door for cells, cages and armouries.
block.aiarsenal.door_wood_army.desc1: Green-painted plank door with a four-light window.
block.aiarsenal.door_lab.desc1: White steel door with a porthole, hazard kick band and push bar.
block.aiarsenal.hatch_steel.desc1: Chequer-plate hatch: floors, decks, cellars. Opens by hand or redstone.
block.aiarsenal.hatch_bunker.desc1: Sealed hatch with a handwheel: the wheel turns, then the lid lifts.
block.aiarsenal.hatch_grate.desc1: Steel bar grating: drains, vents, shafts.
block.aiarsenal.gate_sliding.desc1: Cantilever gate with chain-link and barbed wire; needs 5 free blocks to the left to roll into. Right-click or redstone on any part.
block.aiarsenal.gate_swing.desc1: Two leaves on concrete posts; they swing away from you.
block.aiarsenal.gate_boom.desc1: Checkpoint barrier with a 4.4 m striped arm. The arm swings up.
block.aiarsenal.gate_blast.desc1: 40 cm steel halves slide into the walls (4 s). Very blast-resistant.
block.aiarsenal.camo_screen_forest.desc1: Hangs between poles and links up like a fence; stops line of sight, not bullets.
block.aiarsenal.camo_canopy_forest.desc1: Place it in the air at roof height: neighbours join into one sagging net, a fringe hangs on the open edges. You can walk under and through it.
block.aiarsenal.camo_bush_forest.desc1: Artificial bush for hiding positions and vehicles; you can walk through it and crouch inside.
block.aiarsenal.camo_screen_desert.desc1: Hangs between poles and links up like a fence; stops line of sight, not bullets.
block.aiarsenal.camo_canopy_desert.desc1: Place it in the air at roof height: neighbours join into one sagging net, a fringe hangs on the open edges. You can walk under and through it.
block.aiarsenal.camo_bush_dry.desc1: Artificial bush for hiding positions and vehicles; you can walk through it and crouch inside.
block.aiarsenal.camo_screen_winter.desc1: Hangs between poles and links up like a fence; stops line of sight, not bullets.
block.aiarsenal.camo_canopy_winter.desc1: Place it in the air at roof height: neighbours join into one sagging net, a fringe hangs on the open edges. You can walk under and through it.
block.aiarsenal.camo_bush_snow.desc1: Artificial bush for hiding positions and vehicles; you can walk through it and crouch inside.
msg.aiarsenal.gate.blocked: Not enough room for the gate: it needs %s x %s free blocks to the right and up.
msg.aiarsenal.ied.mode_remote: IED: REMOTE (link a detonator with sneak + right-click)
msg.aiarsenal.wreck.blocked: Not enough room for the wreck: it needs %s x %s x %s blocks.
block.aiarsenal.wreck_tank_hull.desc1: Hull of a T-72B after an ammunition fire: the turret is gone, one track has come off. Real size: 6.9 x 3.5 m.
block.aiarsenal.wreck_tank_turret.desc1: The turret thrown off by the ammo-rack explosion, lying on its side, with the bent 2A46 125 mm gun.
block.aiarsenal.wreck_tank_track.desc1: A run of track torn off the running gear, with a loose road wheel.
block.aiarsenal.wreck_heli_body.desc1: Forward fuselage of a downed Mi-24V: crazed tandem canopies, engines, stub wing with a B-8V20 pod. Real size.
block.aiarsenal.wreck_heli_tail.desc1: Tail boom broken off at the fuselage: fin, stabilisers and the remains of the tail rotor.
block.aiarsenal.wreck_heli_rotor.desc1: Bent 8.6 m main rotor blade with its root fitting and a broken piece of another blade.
block.aiarsenal.wreck_jet_body.desc1: Belly-landed forward fuselage of a MiG-29: shattered canopy, empty cockpit (the seat ejected), LERX and intakes.
block.aiarsenal.wreck_jet_wing.desc1: Torn-off outer wing lying upside down: pylons, an APU-73 rail and half an R-73 missile.
block.aiarsenal.wreck_jet_tail.desc1: Tail section with a fin, a stabilator and the heat-blued RD-33 nozzle.
block.aiarsenal.crate_ammo.desc1: Green wooden ammo box with rope handles. Placed in creative it comes filled with loot.
block.aiarsenal.crate_medical.desc1: White steel box with a red cross: bandages, first aid kits, rations. Placed in creative it comes filled with loot.
block.aiarsenal.crate_military.desc1: Olive steel case with corner protectors. Placed in creative it comes filled with loot.
block.aiarsenal.crate_weapons.desc1: Long fibreglass case with four latches. Placed in creative it comes filled with loot.
block.aiarsenal.crate_secret.desc1: Black case with a keypad and a red-star band. Something valuable inside. Placed in creative it comes filled with loot.
block.aiarsenal.trap_punji.desc1: Dig a hole and place it: sharpened bamboo stakes under a leaf mat. Whoever steps on it falls in and is wounded and slowed.
block.aiarsenal.trap_spike_strip.desc1: Laid across a road: wounds and slows people, shreds the tyres of vehicles driving over it.
block.aiarsenal.trap_flare.desc1: Non-lethal. A tripwire to the right fires a red flare, alerts players within 64 blocks and makes intruders glow. Re-arm with gunpowder.
block.aiarsenal.trap_ied.desc1: Improvised device, ~3 kg TNT. Right-click toggles PRESSURE / REMOTE; link a remote detonator with sneak + right-click. Shears disarm.
block.aiarsenal.trap_electric_fence.desc: Connects like a fence. Live while any section gets a redstone signal: shocks and throws back whoever touches it.
item.aiarsenal.ration_irp.desc1: Individual ration pack: restores a lot of hunger.
item.aiarsenal.first_aid_kit.desc1: Hold right-click for 2 s: Regeneration II for 6 s, cures poison.
item.aiarsenal.ration_irp.desc: Individual ration pack: restores a lot of hunger.
item.aiarsenal.first_aid_kit.desc: Hold right-click for 2 s: Regeneration II for 6 s, cures poison.
hud.aiarsenal.rw.dmg.blowout: Ammo rack blow-out - panels vented, crew safe
item.aiarsenal.radio.desc: Right click: call fire support - artillery, FAB-500/1000 carpet, FAB-5000, nuclear strike
gui.aiarsenal.radio.title: R-187P1 "Azart" - fire support
gui.aiarsenal.radio.desc.artillery: 2S19 Msta-S battery: 3 salvos x 6 rounds 3OF45. First impact ~12 s.
gui.aiarsenal.radio.desc.fab500: Flight of 4 Su-34, 8 x FAB-500 each: carpet ~100 x 70 m.
gui.aiarsenal.radio.desc.fab1000: Pair of Su-34, 4 x FAB-1000 each: carpet ~90 x 30 m.
gui.aiarsenal.radio.desc.fab5000: Tu-95 drops one FAB-5000 (2.4 t TNT).
gui.aiarsenal.radio.desc.nuclear: Tu-160 drops a 22 kt free-fall bomb. Air burst or remote fuze. Survival: uses one RDS-1.
gui.aiarsenal.radio.no_target: not set - map, crosshair or designator
gui.aiarsenal.radio.hint: Range 3 km. Click the map, then Close.
msg.aiarsenal.radio.ack.artillery: Grom, this is Berkut: fire mission %s / %s, battery fires, impact in %s s
msg.aiarsenal.radio.ack.fab500: Berkut: four Su-34 inbound to %s / %s, bombs in %s s
msg.aiarsenal.radio.ack.fab1000: Berkut: pair of Su-34 inbound to %s / %s, bombs in %s s
msg.aiarsenal.radio.ack.fab5000: Berkut: Tu-95 with FAB-5000 inbound to %s / %s, impact in %s s
msg.aiarsenal.radio.ack.nuclear: Berkut: Tu-160 with special munition inbound to %s / %s, release + %s s. TAKE COVER!
msg.aiarsenal.radio.busy: This strike is already in progress
msg.aiarsenal.radio.need_rds1: A nuclear strike needs an RDS-1 charge in the inventory
tooltip.aiarsenal.uniform.su_afghan: 1980s M88 'afghanka' in khaki, panama hat with a red star, 'СА' field shoulder boards, kirza boots.
tooltip.aiarsenal.uniform.su_tanker: Black-blue tank crew overall and padded tank helmet with headphones, kirza boots.
tooltip.aiarsenal.uniform.us_vietnam: OG-107 olive fatigues, M1 helmet with a 'Mitchell' cover and elastic band, jungle boots.
item.aiarsenal.uniform_us_vietnam_head: M1 helmet, Mitchell cover (US Army, Vietnam)
tooltip.aiarsenal.uniform.us_desert: DCU three-colour desert uniform, PASGT helmet with desert cover and dust goggles, desert boots.
item.aiarsenal.uniform_us_desert_head: PASGT helmet with goggles (US Army, Desert Storm)
tooltip.aiarsenal.uniform.ru_vdv: 'Gorka' suit with reinforcements, telnyashka, sky-blue beret, VDV sleeve patch, black boots.
tooltip.aiarsenal.uniform.ru_pilot: Flight coverall with harness, PPK anti-g suit, ZSh-7 helmet with smoke visor and KM-34 oxygen mask.
item.aiarsenal.uniform_ru_pilot_head: ZSh-7 helmet with mask (Russian Aerospace Forces pilot)
item.aiarsenal.uniform_ru_pilot_chest: Flight coverall, top (Russian Aerospace Forces pilot)
hud.aiarsenal.rw.smoke.empty: Smoke grenades used up (hold R standing still to reload)
hud.aiarsenal.rw.crew.replaced: %s: seat taken, the crew fights on
hud.aiarsenal.rw.crew.moving: %s moves to the seat of the %s
